assumptions.statement: A named operational airfield or port (ICAO station) in each conflict zone represents the weather regime facing operations in that theatre better than a geographic polygon centroid.
assumptions.test: Compare primary ICAO station stoplights against alternate theatre stations in config/points.json; split a zone if coastal and inland hubs diverge systematically.

assumptions.statement: Raw multi-model ensemble member fractions across 82 members (31 NOAA GEFS + 51 ECMWF IFS) provide usable probability estimates for ICD 203 bands prior to post-processing calibration.
assumptions.test: Resolve 90 days of Vis forecasts in Verdict against ICAO METAR/SYNOP observations and check Murphy reliability per probability bin.

assumptions.statement: Requiring at least 3 hours in a UTC day for wind, ceiling, visibility, heat and cold (and 2 hours for freezing rain) filters out brief convective gusts that do not close an operational window.
assumptions.test: Check false-alarm rate of 1-hour vs 3-hour duration rules against aviation METAR flight-category reductions.
